_comment: One entry per custom function to create in the Retell agent. Replace BASE_URL with the API address (for example https://43-205-17-140.sslip.io). In Retell, switch OFF 'Payload: args only' so the request includes the call details; the backend uses them to find the salon and the caller's number.

tools.name: get_salon_info
tools.description: Get the salon's name, address, phone, opening hours, today's date and the current time. Call this at the very start of every call.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services that can be booked, with their ids, length in minutes and price.

tools.name: list_staff
tools.description: List the stylists, optionally only those who perform a service. Use only when the caller asks for a specific person or asks who is available.

service_id.description: Only stylists who do this service (id from list_services).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Find free appointment times for a service on a date (or the next day that has space). Offer at most three of the returned times, using their 'spoken' wording.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD in the salon's local time. Work it out from today's date in get_salon_info.

staff_id.description: Only if the caller asked for a particular stylist.

time_of_day.description: Only if the caller stated a preference.

after.description: Only times at or after this 24-hour time, e.g. 15:30.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book an appointment. Call ONLY after reading the details back and getting a clear yes. The booking exists only if the result says success is true.
tools.speak_during_execution_message: One moment while I book that.

staff_id.description: staff_id of the chosen slot from check_availability.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, exactly as in the chosen slot.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM, exactly as in the chosen slot.

phone.description: Only if the caller wants it under a different number than the one they are calling from.

tools.name: find_my_bookings
tools.description: List the caller's upcoming bookings. Uses their caller ID; if they booked under another number, pass that number and their name.

phone.description: Only if different from the number they are calling from.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Move an existing booking to a new time. Call ONLY after agreeing the new time and getting a clear yes. It has happened only if success is true.
tools.speak_during_execution_message: One moment while I move that.

reference.description: The booking reference from find_my_bookings or given by the caller.

customer_name.description: The caller's name, used to verify the booking is theirs.

phone.description: Only if the booking is under a different number.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking. Call ONLY after reading it back and getting a clear yes. It has happened only if success is true.
tools.speak_during_execution_message: One moment while I cancel that.

customer_name.description: The caller's name, used to verify the booking is theirs.

phone.description: Only if the booking is under a different number.
